purpose: Context screening diagnostics only; no language certification, aspect sentiment or concern prevalence
normalisation: Use the hash-bound accepted collector clean() function: Unicode NFKC, formatting/URL removal, casefold and whitespace normalisation.
precedence: Evaluate each base-term occurrence independently. Suppress an occurrence if any same-theme/same-term rule span contains it; retain the term if any occurrence survives. Record every fired rule ID, sorted and unique. No sentiment inference.
language_policy: Unicode letter-script risk flags only. Latin script does not establish English. Any non-Latin letter triggers a risk flag, including names and mixed text. Recommendation denominators are unchanged.
residual_policy: Other terms and ambiguous contexts remain unvalidated mentions. Praise, negation, sarcasm, boss roles and hard-to-recommend uses are not classified as concern sentiment.

fresh_audit.selection: One eligible review per nonempty stratum, lowest SHA256(salt:review_key). Short texts excluded. No accuracy or population inference from the stratified audit.
fresh_audit.rule_revision: Any refinement after inspecting the fresh audit requires a new method version and a new untouched holdout.
